title: Gemini Skills saved me hours every week by turning my best prompts into templates
content_html:
Published Jul 27, 2026, 8:15 AM EDT

Irene Okpanachi is a Features writer covering Android devices, laptops, portable projectors, VR headsets, software, and AI recorders for Android Police and Talk Android.

She has five years' experience across the Tech, E-commerce, and Food niches, with over 1,000 posts published. The Tech space is where she geeks out most, particularly Android.

Irene holds certifications in Graphic Design (HerTechTrail), Writing in Plain Language (LinkedIn), and English for IT (Cisco Networking Academy).

Beyond writing, Irene is a gamer, singer/songwriter, food lover, and a Jack of all trades.

Outdated hardware eventually becomes a barrier to new software. My 2018 Intel MacBook struggled to run Chrome without its fans sounding like a generator.

Upgrading my personal computer to an M1 Mac allowed me to use the browser again. Then the Gemini sidebar reminded me why I never warmed to using artificial intelligence inside it.

I got tired of repeating instructions and refining prompts. Then I discovered the time-saving Gemini Skills. The feature only launched a few months ago, so I hadn't missed out for long.

Here's how it's improving my routine every day.

My newfound abilities are straight from the source

It saves me from running into dead ends

Google launched Gemini Skills in May 2026. It allows me to save my most-used and effective commands as reusable templates instead of rewriting them every time.

Gemini Spark powers Gemini Skills and serves as Google's experimental workspace for building AI workflows. Google's documentation says it requires a qualifying Google AI subscription, with AI Pro or AI Ultra in the US and AI Ultra in many other supported regions.

Although I can use Skills through Gemini in Chrome, I can't access the full in-app experience. They're not available in my location. But it didn't stop me from building workflows around my own writing process.

Before becoming a consumer tech writer, I spent a year ghostwriting top-of-funnel (TOFU) business-to-business (B2B) content. It taught me how research is surprisingly the most important part of the process.

Most of the writing becomes much easier when you've gathered credible sources and statistics. But I struggle to find the right links because search results are usually outdated or come from sources without much authority.

Even when the information is accurate, it isn't always the primary source, which makes it hard to cite it confidently. AI can surface interesting numbers quickly, but it hallucinates data a lot.

It's why I don't like relying on it without further research, which wastes my time. Before, I'd manually search online for materials published within a specific date range. Now, I've created a skill called Source Tracer.

I instructed it to ignore news articles or blogs until it finds the root study, company report, government data, or other primary source a figure came from.

Visit chrome://skills/yourSkills on the Chrome PC browser and click Add to create a new skill.

Alternatively, tap the menu icon in the upper-left corner of the web page, and select Browse skills to choose from Google's collection.

You'll fill in a form prompting you to name your skill, add an optional description, and write the instructions Gemini should follow whenever you call it.

I ensured mine explained whether statistics are being quoted accurately, included a direct link, and flagged cases where it can't verify claims.

So, if I come across one, I launch the Gemini Sidebar and type / to bring up available skills. Then I select Source Tracer and paste the content to audit it.

Example instruction: Trace every statistic back to its original primary source. Ignore blogs, news articles, and AI-generated summaries unless they directly cite the source. Prioritize academic papers, government databases, corporate reports, regulatory filings, or official press releases.

Verify that the statistic is quoted accurately, explain any missing context or caveats, include a direct citation or link to the original publication, and rate the source's reliability. If the primary source can't be found, explicitly say so instead of guessing.

I compare products A and B like a pro

Not many people know the difference

I can't do without my Spec Compare skill, both professionally and casually. Part of my job involves reviewing devices to figure out which one offers more buyer value.

I can't possibly own every device, so I spend idle time reading official product pages, specification sheets, reviews, and announcements. I also use it before buying products to slow down my impulses.

It helps me monitor trends and understand where manufacturers are cutting corners. I used to switch between browser tabs and copy specifications. Then I'd paste them in Google Sheets or create a table in Docs to view them side-by-side.

It wasn't difficult, but it was repetitive and easy to lose track of smaller differences. Now, I open the official product pages for two devices in separate Chrome tabs. Then I invoke the skill and attach the relevant tabs to the prompt box.

Gemini does all the work when I press the Enter button on my keyboard.

Example instructions: Compare the products in the selected browser tabs. Extract their prices, specifications, features, pros, and cons. Then present the information in a side-by-side table, then analyze their performance, design, software, battery life, cameras, value for money, and ideal buyer.

Stay neutral, explain the trade-offs instead of picking a winner, and link every specification or claim to its original product page.

Show off your AI skills

Building Skills made me appreciate other ways of customizing longer, role-based conversations. I now use Gemini Gems more in the mobile app.

Skills are reusable workflows for repetitive tasks, while Gems are dedicated assistants with their own personalities and instructions. I use them to aid learning and work on complicated projects.

Among my favorites is Learning Coach. Normal Gemini chat usually answers my questions as quickly as possible. But Coach exists on Google's LearnLM technology, which applies educational science.

It breaks down topics into smaller bits and adjusts explanations to fit my pace.

content_html_zh:
发布于 2026 年 7 月 27 日上午 8:15（美国东部时间）

Irene Okpanachi 是一位专题作家，涵盖 Android 设备、笔记本电脑、便携式投影仪、VR 耳机、软件以及适用于 Android Police 和 Talk Android 的 AI 录音机。

她在科技、电子商务和食品领域拥有 5 年经验，发表了 1,000 多篇帖子。 科技领域是她最感兴趣的领域，尤其是 Android。

Irene 拥有平面设计 (HerTechTrail)、平白语言写作 (LinkedIn) 和 IT 英语 (思科网络学院) 认证。

除了写作之外，艾琳还是一名游戏玩家、歌手/词曲作者、美食爱好者和多才多艺。

过时的硬件最终会成为新软件的障碍。 我的 2018 款 Intel MacBook 很难运行 Chrome，但风扇的声音就像发电机一样。

将我的个人电脑升级到 M1 Mac 让我可以再次使用浏览器。 然后 Gemini 侧边栏提醒我为什么我从来不热衷于在其中使用人工智能。

我厌倦了重复说明和完善提示。 然后我发现了节省时间的双子座技能。 该功能几个月前才推出，所以我并没有错过太久。

以下是它如何改善我每天的日常生活。

我新发现的能力是直接来自于源头的

它使我免于陷入死胡同

Google 于 2026 年 5 月推出了 Gemini Skills。 它允许我将最常用和有效的命令保存为可重用模板，而不是每次都重写它们。

Gemini Spark 为 Gemini Skills 提供支持，并作为 Google 用于构建 AI 工作流程的实验工作区。 谷歌的文档称，它需要合格的谷歌AI订阅，在美国有AI Pro或AI Ultra，在许多其他受支持的地区有AI Ultra。

尽管我可以在 Chrome 中通过 Gemini 使用技能，但我无法访问完整的应用内体验。 它们在我的位置不可用。 但这并没有阻止我围绕自己的写作过程构建工作流程。

在成为一名消费者技术作家之前，我花了一年时间代写漏斗顶部 (TOFU) 企业对企业 (B2B) 内容。 它告诉我研究如何令人惊讶地成为这个过程中最重要的部分。

当您收集了可靠的来源和统计数据后，大多数写作都会变得容易得多。 但我很难找到正确的链接，因为搜索结果通常已经过时或来自没有太多权威的来源。

即使信息准确，它也并不总是主要来源，这使得很难自信地引用它。 人工智能可以快速呈现有趣的数字，但它会产生很多幻觉数据。

这就是为什么我不喜欢在没有进一步研究的情况下依赖它，这会浪费我的时间。 以前，我会手动在线搜索特定日期范围内发布的材料。 现在，我创建了一项名为“源追踪器”的技能。

我指示它忽略新闻文章或博客，直到它找到数据的根源研究、公司报告、政府数据或其他主要来源。

在 Chrome PC 浏览器上访问 chrome://skills/yourSkills，然后单击“添加”以创建新技能。

或者，点击网页左上角的菜单图标，然后选择浏览技能以从 Google 的集合中进行选择。

您将填写一份表格，提示您命名您的技能，添加可选描述，并编写 Gemini 在您调用该技能时应遵循的说明。

我确保我的解释是否准确地引用了统计数据，包括直接链接，并标记了无法验证索赔的情况。

因此，如果我遇到一个，我会启动 Gemini 侧边栏并输入 / 来调出可用的技能。 然后我选择 Source Tracer 并粘贴内容以对其进行审核。

示例说明：将每个统计数据追溯到其原始主要来源。 忽略博客、新闻文章和人工智能生成的摘要，除非它们直接引用来源。 优先考虑学术论文、政府数据库、公司报告、监管文件或官方新闻稿。 验证统计数据是否准确引用，解释任何缺失的上下文或警告，包括直接引用或原始出版物的链接，并对来源的可靠性进行评级。 如果找不到主要来源，请明确说明而不是猜测。

我像专业人士一样比较产品 A 和 B

没有多少人知道其中的区别

无论是专业还是休闲，我都离不开规格比较技能。 我的部分工作包括审查设备，以确定哪一款设备能为买家提供更多价值。

我不可能拥有所有设备，因此我会花空闲时间阅读官方产品页面、规格表、评论和公告。 我也在购买产品之前使用它来减缓我的冲动。

它帮助我监控趋势并了解制造商在哪里偷工减料。 我曾经在浏览器选项卡和复制规范之间切换。 然后我会将它们粘贴到 Google 表格中或在文档中创建一个表格以并排查看它们。

这并不困难，但它是重复的，并且很容易忘记较小的差异。 现在，我在单独的 Chrome 选项卡中打开两个设备的官方产品页面。 然后我调用该技能并将相关选项卡附加到提示框。

当我按下键盘上的 Enter 按钮时，Gemini 就会完成所有工作。

示例说明：比较所选浏览器选项卡中的产品。 提取它们的价格、规格、功能、优缺点。 然后将信息呈现在并排的表格中，然后分析它们的性能、设计、软件、电池寿命、相机、物有所值和理想买家。 保持中立，解释权衡而不是选择获胜者，并将每个规格或声明链接到其原始产品页面。

展示你的人工智能技能

培养技能让我欣赏了定制更长的、基于角色的对话的其他方法。 我现在更多地在移动应用程序中使用 Gemini Gems。

技能是重复任务的可重复使用的工作流程，而宝石是具有自己个性和指示的专用助手。 我用它们来帮助学习和处理复杂的项目。

我最喜欢的是学习教练。 正常的双子座聊天通常会尽快回答我的问题。 但 Coach 存在于谷歌的 LearnLM 技术之上，该技术应用了教育科学。

它将主题分解为更小的部分并调整解释以适应我的节奏。
